note: 24/7 pediatric advice by Zoom (add the contact `charlie1@rccbc.ca`; it takes no email) or phone (236-305-5352) from pediatricians, pediatric emergency physicians and pediatric intensivists, for physicians, NPs, nurses and midwives in rural, remote and First Nations communities in BC
